definitions.explanation: Aromatic plant-derived substances used to flavor food, such as pepper, cinnamon, or ginger.

examples.japanese: カレーには{様々|さまざま}な{香辛料|こうしんりょう}が{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Various spices are used in curry.

examples.japanese: {香辛料|こうしんりょう}を{効|き}かせた{料理|りょうり}が{好|す}きです。
examples.english: I like dishes with strong spice flavors.

examples.japanese: この{肉|にく}には{香辛料|こうしんりょう}がたっぷり{塗|ぬ}ってある。
examples.english: This meat is generously rubbed with spices.

notes:
Common spices (香辛料):
- こしょう/ペッパー (pepper)
- シナモン (cinnamon)
- {生姜|しょうが} (ginger)
- にんにく (garlic)
- {唐辛子|とうがらし} (chili pepper)
- クミン (cumin)
- ターメリック (turmeric)
- {山椒|さんしょう} (Japanese pepper)
- わさび (wasabi)

Japanese cuisine traditionally uses fewer spices than South Asian or Middle Eastern cuisines, relying more on {薬味|やくみ} (condiments/garnishes).

Also called スパイス in casual speech.
